title: Generative
description:
An exercise in manipulating MIDI messaging. Using only one MIDI source, messaging was sent to multiple other tracks with cascaded arpeggiators of different note lengths and extensions. This hierarchy and structure results in one MIDI message, a chord for example, triggering multiple devices at different intervals, lengths, and chords. In addition to the structure, two hooks were created with automation applied to modify the sound. This is intended to resemble a sound design display where various sensors would modify these parameters in real time. 

I ultimately ended up creating a dark ambient sounding group, with that I felt  dissociative and anxiety inducing parameters were appropriate. With that, I felt a dissociative feeling could be felt by introducing noise that drowns out the original tracks. Anxiety was implemented by increaing delay repetitions to the active parts within the MIDI structure with changing stereo panning to cause rapid, accelerating parts to hop all around the listener.

videos.label: Generative Ableton Project
videos.caption: Recording of my Ableton project with the Generative project. Viewing the timeline, you can see only one MIDI chord is sustained during the entire playback time. A breakdown of the individual instruments shows the MIDI manipulation done via the arpeggiators. Lastly, the automation is shown to mimic sensor data modifying the collective sound.
